description: Fetch bounded metadata for an explicitly supplied HTTPS social-platform link. This does not watch its video or audio. Requires a creative-task grant because it invokes an external scraper. Returns source metadata, coverage, provenance and a content hash; it does not imply full video inspection.

projectId.description: ID of the Playground project chosen for this task; obtain it from project creation, an explicit project link or current context.

url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the source to inspect or import; use the original source link.

name: playground_external_link_inspect
title: Inspect a supplied social link
